description: This file defines the SideMenu class which represents the side menu component in a web UI automation context, providing methods to open various sections of the application by interacting with web elements.

classes.name: SideMenu
classes.description: Represents the side menu in the web UI, providing methods to navigate to different sections.

methods.name: OpenDashboard
methods.description: Clicks the Dashboard menu item to navigate to the dashboard page.

methods.name: OpenPim
methods.description: Clicks the PIM menu item to navigate to the PIM page.

methods.name: OpenLeave
methods.description: Clicks the Leave menu item to navigate to the Leave page.

methods.name: OpenRecruitment
methods.description: Clicks the Recruitment menu item to navigate to the Recruitment page.

methods.name: OpenTime
methods.description: Clicks the Time menu item to navigate to the Time page.

methods.name: OpenAdmin
methods.description: Clicks the Admin menu item to navigate to the Admin page.
